text: Browser timeline includes initial change request and later acceptance. Reviewer requested clear callback and opaque storeToken contracts, meaningful partial-work rollback test, and discussion of missing .msf recovery. Landed patch adds test_midwayFail with mixed retained/discarded messages and checksum comparison. Author chose onRetentionQuery rather than getShouldKeepMessage. Review did not add automatic .msf recovery.
title: D207101 store compaction review
